mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 5.2% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as higher unemployment signals weakening labor demand and reduced economic growth prospects.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite the trigger or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in INDPRO and GDPC1 above their 5-year moving averages signal robust demand and production, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days through expanded economic activity.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 both above 5-year moving averages
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as higher interest rates compress equity valuations and reduce investment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rise in UNRATE above 5.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as investors anticipate the end of the expansion and buy stocks preemptively.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.0% in late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the trigger or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in GDPC1 and HOUST above 10% MoM growth trigger positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days as strong consumption and housing demand boost economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both above 10% MoM growth
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in FEDFUNDS below 2.5% in a monetary tightening cycle triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as investors anticipate easing and react to the unexpected rate cut.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops below 2.5% in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS above 1.5 million and UNRATE above 5.0% simultaneously trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as signals of recessionary pressures suppress growth expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not negative or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
